item.title: How India's telecom market quietly became a duopoly in 2025
item.description: India's telecom market quietly consolidated into a duopoly in 2025, with Jio and Airtel dominating 5G and ARPU growth, and shaping future competition.

item.title: Eurobites: Telenor finally exits Pakistan
item.description: Also in today's EMEA regional roundup: EXA wraps up Aqua Comms acquisition; Enea lands DPI gig with Asian government; Eutelsat brings rail connectivity to Gabon.

item.title: EchoStar-SpaceX deal will create spectrum 'dead zone,' warns Liberty LatAm
item.description: In this roundup of responses to EchoStar's spectrum sale to SpaceX, Liberty Latin America argues that the transaction, and its focus on D2D services, will strand the spectrum it acquired from EchoStar in 2024.

item.title: Incoming Cable One CEO will face tough challenges
item.description: Cable vet Jim Holanda will succeed Julie Laulis as Cable One's CEO. He'll be tasked with returning Cable One to growth amid broadband sub losses and stock drops that could make Cable One a tempting takeover target.

item.title: New China Mobile chief must find path back to growth
item.description: Ex-Unicom boss Chen Zhongyue takes over top job at China Mobile as the digital enterprise boom fades and the operator must find a new way to grow.

item.title: DirecTV launches streaming service for small businesses
item.description: DirecTV has introduced a new streaming TV offering tailored for small businesses, with plans to develop a version for larger businesses. The new offering presents a new option for business buildings that can't use satellite-based tech. #pressrelease

item.title: Versant completes Comcast spin-off
item.description: Versant, a company that runs a slate of cable networks and owns digital assets and services such as Rotten Tomatoes, has spun off from Comcast. Starting today, Versant is trading today on the Nasdaq under the 'VSNT' ticker. #pressrelease

item.title: AT&T preps beta D2D satellite service with AST SpaceMobile
item.description: AT&T to start offering pre-commercial D2D satellite service via AST SpaceMobile in first half of this year, but commercial launch timeline is not yet determined.

item.title: Point Broadband, Clearwave Fiber to combine
item.description: Point Broadband signed a definitive agreement to combine with Clearwave Fiber. The combined company will be jointly controlled by GTCR and Berkshire Partners. #pressrelease

item.title: Whale TV's OS connects with more connected TV brands
item.description: Whale TV said its operating system for connected TVs is expanding in parts of Europe, Brazil and Australia after cutting licensing deals with five TV brands: Aiwa, Blaupunkt, EFL, Onvo and JVC. #pressrelease
